ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent hold on Medicaid funding in Minnesota and the potential for widespread fraud and abuse.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and abuse of taxpayer dollars. By following the money and investigating the sources of the fraud, we may be able to identify those responsible and bring them to justice.
